title: DexterLens
tagline: AI-powered conversations with any YouTube video
description: DexterLens is a full-stack AI application that transforms YouTube videos into interactive, promptable knowledge. Instead of searching through an entire video manually, simply paste a YouTube video URL, get the transcript, combine it with your request, and generate responses.

title: Terraq
tagline: Satellite-powered agricultural and land analytics platform
description: Terraq is a satellite-powered agricultural analytics platform built with React, TypeScript, Mapbox, Google Earth Engine, and Gemini. It provides NDVI analysis, soil and climate data, land-use classification, satellite imagery, and AI-powered crop planning through an interactive map dashboard.
